DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市の相談予約についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about booking a city consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内に電話予約とありますが、平日は職場で電話を掛けられません。文字で申し込む方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務中に電話できず文字で予約する方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The information says to book by phone, but I cannot make calls at work on weekdays. Is there a way to apply in writing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to book in writing because you cannot phone while working. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この相談は窓口でも予約を受けます。今、ご希望を伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also accept bookings for this consultation at the counter. Shall I take your preferences now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。平日の夕方なら来られます。家計の支払いの相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来庁可能な時間帯と相談内容を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I can come on weekday evenings. I would like advice about household payments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State when you can visit city hall and what you want to discuss. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談の担当へ空き枠を確認します。来週木曜日の夕方はいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check available slots with the consultation staff. How about next Thursday evening?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木曜日は大丈夫です。仕事が終わる時刻が動くので、時間を少し遅くできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木曜を選び開始時刻の調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thursday is fine. My finishing time at work varies, so could the time be a little later?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose Thursday and ask to adjust the starting time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後の枠が五時です。遅れそうな時は、案内にある連絡方法をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The last slot is at five. If you think you will be late, use the contact method in the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 五時を希望します。連絡方法は紙で受け取りたいです。携帯では文字が小さくて読みにくいので。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五時を選び紙の連絡案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like five o'clock. I would like the contact instructions on paper because the text on my mobile is small and difficult to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose five o'clock and ask for contact instructions on paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日時と連絡先を大きめに印刷します。初回に持参する資料も下へ載せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will print the date, time, and contact details in a fairly large size. I will also list the documents to bring to the first visit below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木曜五時と読めました。資料をそろえて来ます。電話せず予約できて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 印刷された日時を読み資料を持参すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can read Thursday at five. I will prepare the documents and come. It helped to be able to book without calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the printed date and time and say you will bring the documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約を受け付けました。木曜日にお待ちしています。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your booking is accepted. We look forward to seeing you on Thursday. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後の説明書で、分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything unclear in the instructions after your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この図の斜線は、薬を塗る場所ですか。診察では右腕と言われましたが、図の左右で迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明書の図で塗り薬を使う左右が分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Do the diagonal lines in this diagram show where to apply the medicine? I was told the right arm during the consultation, but I was confused by left and right in the diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the diagram does not make it clear which side to apply the medicine to. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 右腕という説明を聞いたのですね。指示の内容を医師へ確認してから、ご一緒に図を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You heard the explanation that it was the right arm. Let us confirm the instructions with the doctor, then look at the diagram together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。私から見て右ではなく、図の人物の右腕ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指示確認を頼み図の人物の右腕という読み方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. It means the right arm of the person in the diagram, rather than the right side as I look at it, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the instructions and whether it means the diagram figure's right arm. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。人物の右腕に付いた斜線です。お客様の腕で、その場所を示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have confirmed it. It is the diagonal shading on the person's right arm. Could you show that place on your own arm?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの腕の、この辺りでしょうか。袖を上げると範囲が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の腕で場所を示して範囲を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is it around here on this arm? If I raise my sleeve, you can see the area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the place on your own arm and check the area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明された範囲を確認できました。使う薬そのものは、処方箋を持って薬局で受け取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have confirmed the area that was explained. For the medicine itself, please take the prescription to the pharmacy and collect it there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この説明書も薬局で見せます。いつ塗るかは書いてありますが、一回の量は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬局に説明書を見せると伝え一回量が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show these instructions at the pharmacy too. They say when to apply it, but I do not know how much to use each time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will show the instructions at the pharmacy and ask about the unclear amount per application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 量は薬剤師にも説明書を見せてご確認ください。こちらにも、質問する項目として印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the instructions to the pharmacist and check the amount too. I will also mark it here as a question to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬局で図と一回の量を確認します。塗る腕が分かったので、書類を持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図と薬の量を薬剤師へ確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the diagram and the amount per application at the pharmacy. Now that I know which arm to apply it to, I will take the paperwork there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the diagram and amount with the pharmacist. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不明な点はそのままお尋ねください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask about anything you are unsure of. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの届出についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the report you made earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、鞄をなくしたと届けた者です。今朝、店から預かっていると電話が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届けた鞄が店で見つかったと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am the person who reported losing a bag yesterday. This morning a shop called to say they were keeping it for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the bag you reported missing was found at a shop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つかったとのことですね。もうご自身で受け取られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it has been found. Have you collected it yourself already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。店で受け取りました。中の手帳と鍵も、自分の物でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取済みで内容から自分の物と確認したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I collected it at the shop. The planner and keys inside were mine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have collected it and confirmed it was yours from its contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できましたね。こちらの届出を確認するため、控えをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You have confirmed it, then. Please show your copy so we can check the report here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この控えです。昨日は財布も入っていると話しましたが、財布は家に残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届出控えを示し財布についての申告を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the copy. Yesterday I said my wallet was also inside, but it had been left at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the report copy and correct what you said about the wallet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も伺います。鞄を受け取った時、ほかに足りない物はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will note that too. When you collected the bag, was anything else missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありませんでした。探していただく必要がなくなったので、届出の更新をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足品がなく届出の更新を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nothing was missing. There is no longer any need to search, so please update the report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say nothing is missing and request an update to the report. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかって受け取ったことを記録します。店で受け取った時刻も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record that it was found and collected. Do you also know what time you collected it at the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の九時半です。鞄も中身もそろったと記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取時刻と鞄の内容がそろったことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Half past nine today. Please record that I have both the bag and all its contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the collection time and that the bag and all contents are present. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録しました。お知らせありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have recorded it. Thank you for letting us know. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にいたのに受け取れませんでした。インターホンが鳴らないことに、あとで気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在宅中に受け取れなかった理由を故障した呼鈴で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was at home but could not receive the delivery. I noticed later that my intercom was not ringing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the missed delivery while at home by saying the doorbell was broken. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 故障しているのですね。再配達をご希望ですか、窓口での受け取りをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is broken, then. Would you prefer redelivery or collection at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 再配達を希望します。直るまで、玄関で声を掛けてもらうよう伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再配達と声での呼び掛けを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like redelivery. Until it is repaired, could you ask the delivery person to call out at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for redelivery and for the delivery person to call out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望を配達担当へ伝えられます。ただ、呼び掛けに気づける時間をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can pass your request to the delivery staff. However, please choose a time when you can notice them calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の午前は玄関の近くにいられます。戸を開けたままにしなくてもよいですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 気づける時間を示し玄関の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can stay near the entrance tomorrow morning. I do not have to leave the door open, do I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give a time when you can notice them and ask what to do with the door. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戸は閉めておいてください。玄関が道路から見えにくい場所なら、目印も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the door closed. If the entrance is hard to see from the road, we will also ask for a landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道路から奥へ入った、青い扉の家です。門には部屋番号が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配達員が分かる扉と部屋番号の目印を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is the house with the blue door, set back from the road. The room number is on the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the delivery person landmarks using the door and room number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 青い扉と部屋番号を担当へ伝えます。再配達の受付内容はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will tell the staff about the blue door and room number. Here are the details of the redelivery request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日の午前でお願いします。インターホンの修理は管理者にも連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 午前の再配達を依頼し修理先へ連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tomorrow morning, please. I will also contact the property manager about repairing the intercom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request morning redelivery and say you will contact the person responsible for repairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付いたしました。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your request is accepted. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ATMでお困りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you have a problem at the ATM?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードが戻らず、機械の画面が止まりました。差込口には少し見えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ATMにカードが残り画面停止したと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My card did not come back out, and the screen froze. A little of it is visible in the slot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the card remains in the ATM and the screen has frozen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に引っ張らず、そのままにしてください。何番の機械ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not pull it out by force; please leave it as it is. What number machine is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二台目の、番号三の機械です。入金をしようとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機械番号と予定した取引を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Machine number three, the second one from the entrance. I was trying to make a deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the machine number and the transaction you intended. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機械の担当を呼びます。現金はもう入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will call the person in charge of the machine. Have you put in any cash yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ入れていません。カードを入れた後で止まりました。通帳は持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金未投入と通帳所持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. It stopped after I inserted the card. I have my passbook with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not inserted cash and have your passbook. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現金を入れる前ですね。カードが戻るまで、通帳でご本人の確認をさせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before putting cash in, then. Until the card is returned, please let us verify your identity using the passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。画面に取引完了とは出ていませんでした。入金済みになっていないかも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳を示し取引が完了していないか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. The screen did not say the transaction was complete. Please also check that it has not been recorded as a completed deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the passbook and ask to check whether the transaction was completed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取引状況も確認します。機械は次の方が使わないよう、係員が表示を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the transaction status too. A staff member will put up a notice so the next person does not use the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。私は窓口の近くで待ちます。カードが戻ったら、入金は窓口で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カード返却を待ち入金の場所を窓口へ替えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check. I will wait near the counter. When the card is returned, I would like to ask about making the deposit at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the card and would like to change the deposit location to the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当がお声を掛けます。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The staff in charge will speak to you. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about a product, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このパンはあん入りと書いてありますが、切ったらクリームが入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食品の表示と中身の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This bread says it has bean-paste filling, but when I cut it, there was cream inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the food's label and its contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外袋とパンを拝見します。購入した日と、残っている数を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the outer package and the bread. Could you tell me when you bought it and how many are left?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝買いました。四個のうち一個を切って、残り三個はそのままです。レシートもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入時刻と切った数とレシート所持を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bought it this morning. I cut one of the four, and the other three are untouched. I also have the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you bought it, how many you cut, and that you have the receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。売場担当へ袋の表示と中身を確認してもらいます。代わりの商品をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. I will ask the sales-floor staff to check the package label and contents. Would you like a replacement product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は別の物を買うので、返品できるか相談したいです。切った一個も持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返品の相談を希望し開いた商品も持参したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will buy something else today, so I would like to ask whether I can return them. I have brought the one I cut as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about a return and say you also brought the opened item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四個と外袋を一緒にお預かりします。確認中、この受付票をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take all four and the outer package together. Please keep this claim slip while we check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付票を受け取りました。確認は今日中でしょうか。ずっとここにはいられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付票を受け取り確認時期を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received the slip. Will the check be finished today? I cannot stay here the whole time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take the claim slip and ask when the check will be done. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から結果をご連絡します。連絡の取りやすい時間を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff in charge will contact you with the result. Please tell us when you can be reached most easily.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午後三時以降なら電話に出られます。今日は商品を預けて、連絡を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品を預け連絡可能な時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can answer the phone after three in the afternoon. I will leave the products here today and wait to hear from you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the products and state when you can be contacted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三時以降にお電話するよう伝えます。お持ちいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ask them to call after three. Thank you for bringing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お散歩の案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions for a walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一度に長く歩かず、休みを入れたいです。ベンチが続いている道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休みを挟めるベンチ沿いの道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take breaks rather than walk a long time at once. Please tell me a path with benches along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a path with benches where you can take breaks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時計台から池までの道に三か所あります。どれも通路のすぐ横です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are three places on the path from the clock tower to the pond. They are all immediately beside the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 時計台から最初のベンチまで、どのくらい離れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初のベンチまでの距離を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: How far is it from the clock tower to the first bench?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the distance to the first bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ゆっくり歩いて三分くらいです。その次は同じくらいの距離ですが、少し坂があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: About three minutes at a slow walk. The next one is about the same distance again, but there is a slight hill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず最初のベンチまでにします。池へ行かなくても、そこで引き返せますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 坂を避け最初の区間で折り返せるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will start by going only to the first bench. I can turn back there without going to the pond, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid the hill and check whether you can turn back after the first section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。向かいの花壇が折り返す目印になります。今、そのベンチで休んでいる人がいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The flowerbed opposite is a landmark for turning back. Someone is resting on that bench now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空いていなければ、時計台の横の椅子まで戻ります。そちらの椅子は今使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチが埋まる場合の戻り先の椅子を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it is not free, I will return to the chairs beside the clock tower. Are those chairs available now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the fallback chairs to return to if the bench is occupied. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使えます。時計台の横なら屋根もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: They are. There is also a roof beside the clock tower.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に屋根の下で少し休んでから、花壇まで歩いて戻ります。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 屋根の下で休んでから短い区間を往復すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest a little under the roof first, then walk to the flowerbed and back. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to rest under the roof before walking the short section there and back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。ご自分のペースでお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are welcome. Please enjoy it at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符の購入について、ご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I help you with buying a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の朝、窓口が開く前に出発します。今日、明日使う切符を買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 早朝出発用の切符を前日に購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I leave tomorrow morning before the ticket counter opens. Can I buy a ticket today to use tomorrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can buy a ticket the day before for an early-morning departure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券売機の切符には使用日の条件があります。こちらでは、日付を指定するお取扱いを確認します。どの列車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tickets from the machine have conditions on the date of use. Here we will check the arrangements for specifying a date. Which train is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明日の六時十二分の列車です。予約席ではなく、普通の座席で行くつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車の日時と座席の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tomorrow's six-twelve train. I intend to use an ordinary seat rather than a reserved one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the train's date and time and your seat preference. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。指定した日付の切符を窓口で用意できます。お一人分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We can prepare a ticket for the specified date at the counter. Is it for one person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人分です。日付は今日ではなく明日にしてください。券面で見分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人分の翌日指定と使用日の印字を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: One person. Please make the date tomorrow, not today. Can I identify it from the print on the ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request one ticket dated tomorrow and ask about the printed date of use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切符のこの部分へ、使用日が印字されます。お渡しした時にお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The date of use will be printed in this part of the ticket. Please check when I give it to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここですね。明日の朝は、この窓口へ寄らずに改札へ進めばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌朝窓口を経由せず改札へ進めるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here, then. Tomorrow morning, can I go to the gates without stopping at this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether you can go straight to the gates without visiting the counter the next morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。明日の切符をお持ちいただき、改札へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please bring the ticket for tomorrow and go to the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では一枚お願いします。今日使う物と混ざらないよう、明日の予定表と一緒に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一枚を依頼し翌日の予定表と一緒に保管すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then one, please. So it does not get mixed with anything I use today, I will put it together with tomorrow's schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request one ticket and say you will keep it with tomorrow's schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが明日の日付の切符です。ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your ticket dated tomorrow. Thank you. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた通知をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the notice you received with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知は、コードを読み取って回答するとあります。携帯で読み取れないので、紙で答えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二次元コードを使えず紙で回答したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice says to scan a code and respond. I cannot scan it with my mobile, so I would like to respond on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to respond on paper because you cannot use the two-dimensional code. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の担当部署を確認します。この調査には紙の回答用紙もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the department responsible for the notice. This survey also has a paper response form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の用紙をください。通知には回答番号がありますが、用紙にも同じ番号を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 回答用紙を求め通知の番号の記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please give me the paper form. There is a response number on the notice. Do I write the same number on the form too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the response form and whether to copy the number from the notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この欄へ通知の番号を写してください。通知そのものは返す必要がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Copy the number on the notice into this field. You do not need to return the notice itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通知は手元に残します。家で書いた用紙を持参してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知を保管し記入後の持参可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will keep the notice. May I bring the completed form after filling it in at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the notice and ask whether you can bring the completed form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当部署の受付へお持ちいただけます。郵送も選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can bring it to the reception desk of the department in charge. Mailing it is also an option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事帰りに持参します。今いる窓口ではなく、通知にある部署へ行くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参先が通知の担当部署か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will bring it after work. I should go to the department on the notice, rather than this counter, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether the place to submit it is the department on the notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうです。二階の調査担当です。用紙の上にも窓口名を印刷しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is right. It is the survey department on the second floor. The counter name is also printed at the top of the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用紙に回答番号を書いて、二階へ持ってきます。コードが使えなくても回答できるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答番号を記し二階へ持参すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write the response number on the form and bring it to the second floor. So I can respond even without using the code.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to write the response number and bring it to the second floor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。用紙をお渡しします。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Here is the form. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。問診票はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Here is the medical questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書くのに少し時間が掛かります。書き終わる前に名前を呼ばれたら、どうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診記入中に呼ばれた場合の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It takes me a little time to write. What should I do if my name is called before I finish?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what to do if you are called while filling in the medical questionnaire. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書きかけでも、問診票を持って受付へお越しください。分からない欄は一緒に伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bring the questionnaire to reception even if it is unfinished. We can ask about any fields you do not understand together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうします。「受診のきっかけ」は、紹介状があることを書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼出しに応じると伝え受診のきっかけ欄の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will do that. For “reason for visiting,” should I write that I have a referral letter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will respond when called and ask what the reason-for-visit field means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紹介状をお持ちなら、そのことをお書きください。今日は封筒も持っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you have a referral letter, please write that. Do you have the envelope with you today too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封筒はかばんに入っています。まだ開けていません。問診票と一緒に渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封の紹介状を問診票と渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The envelope is in my bag. I have not opened it. I will hand it in with the questionnaire.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand in the unopened referral letter with the questionnaire. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。紹介状はこちらでお預かりします。今、困っている症状も書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We will take the referral letter here. Could you also write the symptoms troubling you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右足が痛むことは書けます。いつからだったかは、予定表を見ないと思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書ける症状と今思い出せない日付を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can write that my right foot hurts. I cannot remember when it started without looking at my schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the symptoms you can write from the date you cannot recall now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今思い出せる範囲で結構です。日付が分かったら、診察前にもお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write what you can remember now. When you know the date, please let us know before the consultation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず右足の痛みを書きます。待っている間に予定表を見て、始まった日を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 症状を先に書き予定表で開始日を確かめると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write about the right foot pain first. While waiting, I will look at my schedule and check the starting date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write the symptoms first and check their starting date in your schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お席でお書きください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please fill it in at your seat. Take care of yourself.
